subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Even if an unlaced shoe is spotless, it is not __neat__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"neat"** means something that is clean, tidy, and orderly in appearance. (साफ, सुव्यवस्थित)

 
 
• **Example: **His desk was always **neat**, with all papers stacked and organized properly.
 
 
 
• **"Soiled" **refers to something that is dirty or stained, the opposite of being clean or neat. (गंदा, मैला)
 
 
• **Example: **Her dress was **soiled **after playing in the mud.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'neat' **is **'soiled'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agile **(फुर्तीला): Able to move quickly and easily.

 
 
• **Example:** The **agile **gymnast performed a series of complex flips and twists.
 
 
 
• **Forged **(नकली): Created falsely or copied dishonestly.
 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of using **forged **documents to gain access to restricted areas.
 
 
 
• **Requisite** (आवश्यक): Necessary for a particular purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** Having a good command of English is **requisite **for this job.
 
 

34:Tb39,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
